descripcion_geo: Desert in the south of Canaan between Negev and Sinai; Israel pilgrimage route and headquarters of Kadesh-Barnea.
importancia_estrategica: Territory traveled by Israel in the desert; Miriam died there and Moses sinned by striking the rock.

historias.descripcion: The congregation of Israel arrives in the desert of Zin in the first month; Miriam dies there and the town has no water.
The twelve spies set out from the desert of Zin to the north to explore Canaan.
The southern border of Judah's tribe ran through the desert of Zin next to the border of Edom.

personajes.descripcion: He sinned in the desert of Zin by striking the rock instead of speaking to it, losing the right to enter Canaan.
She died and was buried in Kadesh, in the desert of Zin.
Explored the Zin Desert at the beginning of Canaan's reconnaissance.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Desert of Zin: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Moses strikes the rock in Zin (Kadesh): His sin prevents him from entering Canaan, a sign that even the greatest mediator must obey exactly.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Moses strikes the rock in Zin (Kadesh): His sin prevents him from entering Canaan, a sign that even the greatest mediator must obey exactly.

cristianismo.descripcion: Paul interprets the desert rock as a figure of Christ who provides spiritual water (1 Cor 10:4).
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Paul interprets the desert rock as a figure of Christ who provides spiritual water (1 Cor 10:4).
